name: Assays in Drug Development
description: Protein and nucleic acid quantification assays; assays for monitoring receptor-drug interaction; enzyme kinetics and inhibition assays; immunoassays and miscellaneous applications; protein-protein interaction inhibition assays; cell viability and cytotoxicity assays; assays for ADME/pharmacokinetic parameters (for example, lipophilicity and membrane permeability, aqueous solubility, microsome stability, plasma stability, plasma protein binding, cytochrome P450 inhibition, tmax, Cmax, t1/2).
